title: Penguins Model
text:
Load Libraries

library(palmerpenguins)
library(dplyr)
library(dbplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(pins)
library(vetiver)

Load in the Data

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(), 
  dbdir = "my-db.duckdb"
  )
data <- dplyr::tbl(con, "penguins") |>
  collect() |>
  drop_na()

head(data, 3)

# A tibble: 3 × 8
  species island    bill_length_mm bill_depth_mm flipper_length_mm body_mass_g
  <fct>   <fct>              <dbl>         <dbl>             <int>       <int>
1 Adelie  Torgersen           39.1          18.7               181        3750
2 Adelie  Torgersen           39.5          17.4               186        3800
3 Adelie  Torgersen           40.3          18                 195        3250
# ℹ 2 more variables: sex <fct>, year <int>


Model

model <- lm(body_mass_g ~ bill_length_mm + species + sex, data = data)

##Results R^2

summary(model)$r.squared

[1] 0.8555369


Intercept and Coefficients

summary(model)$coefficients

                   Estimate Std. Error   t value     Pr(>|t|)
(Intercept)      2169.26972 271.752535  7.982519 2.435949e-14
bill_length_mm     32.53689   7.302598  4.455522 1.149769e-05
speciesChinstrap -298.76553  85.947166 -3.476153 5.771218e-04
speciesGentoo    1094.86739  74.029471 14.789615 2.810935e-38
sexmale           547.36692  43.205934 12.668790 3.254582e-30


Column names used in the model matrix

colnames(model.matrix(model))

[1] "(Intercept)"      "bill_length_mm"   "speciesChinstrap" "speciesGentoo"   
[5] "sexmale"         


Create a vetiver model

v <- vetiver_model(model, "penguins_model")

Registered S3 method overwritten by 'butcher':
  method                 from    
  as.character.dev_topic generics


Save to Board

model_board <- board_folder("~/data/model", versioned = TRUE)

vetiver_pin_write(model_board, v)

title: Penguins EDA
text:
library(palmerpenguins)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(), 
  dbdir = "my-db.duckdb"
  )
data <- dplyr::tbl(con, "penguins")

Penguin Sizes and Mass by Species

data |> 
  group_by(species, sex) |> 
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_body_mass = mean(body_mass_g, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_bill_length = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_flipper_length = mean(flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_bill_depth = mean(bill_depth_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) |> 
  knitr::kable()

Comparison of body mass and bill length by species

ggplot(data, mapping= aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = body_mass_g, color = species)) +
geom_point(size = 1) + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(
    title = "Penguin Body Mass vs Bill Length",
    x = "Bill Length (mm)",
    y = "Body Mass (g)"
  )
